Creature that Returns an Instant or Sorcery from Graveyard to Hand on Entering

5487-7845--178--179.description:
Cast Molten Duplication by paying its mana cost targeting the creature that can recur spells.
When you cast that spell, Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Molten Duplication and choosing Spinerock Tyrant as its target.
Resolve the copy of Molten Duplication, creating a Spinerock Tyrant token.
Resolve the original Molten Duplication, creating a token copy of the spell recursion creature.
When that token enters, it triggers, returning Molten Duplication from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time, resulting in a total of five Spinerock Tyrants.
Cast the spell that creates a Treasure token by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature.
Each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying that spell once for each Spinerock Tyrant you control.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating at least one Treasure token each time.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding one mana per Treasure.
Cast Molten Duplication by paying its mana cost targeting the spell recursion creature.
When you cast that spell, each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Molten Duplication once for each Spinerock Tyrant and choosing the spell recursion creature once and Spinerock Tyrant as each additional spell's target.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating two copies of the spell recursion creature and additional copies of Spinerock Tyrant.
When the first spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning the spell that creates Treasure from your graveyard to your hand.
 When the second spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning Molten Duplication from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 7.
5487-7845--178--179.notes: The mana needed is calculated assuming you use a spell that costs 2 to cast and creates one Treasure token.

If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3122-3908.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1619-2511-4605-5542-6153.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Vicious Battlerager from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Vicious Battlerager.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Vicious Battlerager token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Vicious Battlerager trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.

Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing White Plume Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.

Resolve the White Plume Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
997-1619-4605-5542-6154.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

Repeat steps 2 and 3 as desired.
Cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost, with {X} being at least 2 if you wish to gain life.

1479-3678-5478-5700-5701.description:

Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2232-2687-5231.description:

When Chancellor of the Forge enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Chancellor of the Forge trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens with haste equal to the number of creatures you control.
When the Phyrexian Goblins enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Chancellor of the Forge to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Cloudstone Curio triggers, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod seven times by sacrificing seven Phyrexian Goblins, adding seven {R}.
Repeat.
If you control at least seven creatures when Chancellor of the Forge enters the battlefield, this combo will net infinite red mana.
